name: flux-file-converter
description: A local-first file converter for macOS
author: Sequoyah Geber

scripts.package: npm run native && npm run build && npm run formats && node scripts/package.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write electron server src scripts tests package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check electron server src scripts tests package.json
scripts.test:web: node tests/web-ui.cjs && node tests/invite-ui.cjs && node tests/login-ui.cjs && node tests/batch-ui.cjs && node tests/reconnect-ui.cjs && node tests/upload-resilience-ui.cjs
scripts.package:mas:dev: npm run native && npm run build && npm run formats && node scripts/mas.cjs --development
scripts.package:mas: npm run native && npm run build && npm run formats && node scripts/mas.cjs
